facts.title: snow pea salad with avocado
ingredients: ½ cup (50 grams) toasted walnuts (see note)
Juice of half a big lemon (1 1/2 tablespoons/20 ml)
Freshly ground black pepper and mild red pepper flakes
1 avocado, halved, pitted, and sliced thin
facts.yield_text: 2 as a main, 4 as a side
facts.author: Deb Perelman
